Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 1934465 - Pass -fno-sized-deallocation and -fno-aligned-new C++ compiler flagsto Clang when building librnp with MOZ_STDCXX_COMPAT (official builds). r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D230884

diff --git a/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild b/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
index 1358f95f181..863ceb746d5 100644
--- a/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
+++ b/third_party/rnpdefs.mozbuild
@@ -32,6 +32,11 @@ if CONFIG["CC_TYPE"] == "clang-cl":
 if CONFIG["MOZ_STDCXX_COMPAT"]:
     # Use pre-GCC-5 strings abi
     DEFINES["_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI"] = 0
+    COMPILE_FLAGS["OS_CXXFLAGS"].extend([
+        "-fno-sized-deallocation",
+        "-fno-aligned-new",
+    ])
+
 
 if CONFIG["OS_ARCH"] in ("Linux", "SunOS"):
     CFLAGS += ["-fPIC"]
